sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-3b"
sources.quote: K2-3b, also known as EPIC 201367065 b, is an exoplanet orbiting the red dwarf K2-3 every 10 days.

introduction.text: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-3. Its orbit and size follow Diamond-Lowe et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-3b"
sources.quote: It is the largest and most massive planet of the K2-3 system, with about 2.1 times the radius of Earth and about 5 times the mass.
